# AstryxSection { #anylumino.AstryxSection }

```python
AstryxSection(children=None, *, variant='section', **props)
```

Render an Astryx section container.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | Default     |
|----------|------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| children | ChildInput | Child widget, sequence of widgets, or mapping of slot names to widgets.                                                                                                                                                                                                | `None`      |
| variant  | str        | Astryx visual variant.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `'section'` |
| **props  | Any        | JSON-safe Section props. Useful keys: width, height, maxWidth, minHeight, dividers, padding, paddingBlock, className, and style. The variant prop supports section, transparent, and muted. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Section>. | `{}`        |
